title: אביר הצללים
summary: היוצרת הופכת ללוחם צללים אפל בשריון שחור-סגול זוהר עם עיניים בוהקות.

phases.what: Eyes glow purple, black veins spread around eyes and neck
Glossy black symbiotic armor creeps up neck and lower face, dark shards float
Full spiked black mask covers face, armor covers chest
Spiked helmet replaces beanie, purple lightning crackles, clawed hand reaches toward camera

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and undergoes a dark fantasy transformation in one continuous 10-second shot. Keep the person recognizable at first as their eyes suddenly glow bright neon purple and black vein-like markings spread across their temples. Glossy, liquid-like black armor creeps up their neck and chest, forming a jagged black mask over their lower face while floating dark shards appear in the smoky air. The armor rapidly engulfs their entire face and head into a menacing spiked black helmet with glowing purple cracks. Finally, the fully armored shadow warrior reaches a dark clawed hand toward the camera as purple lightning strikes behind them. Cinematic dark lighting with neon purple rim light, vertical framing.
